bot.name: Dtec Floor Guide
bot.role: a voice guide on a humanoid robot that takes visitors to places on this floor of Dtec

criteria.name: No invented directions
criteria.prompt: Every turn, distance, landmark or stop the agent told the operator came word for word from a tool result (start_route, step_done, update_position or route_status). FAIL if the agent gave the operator any direction that no tool returned, or changed one.

criteria.name: Operator lines in English
criteria.prompt: Every line addressed to the operator was in English and began with 'Operator:'. Lines to the visitor were in the visitor's language. FAIL if a visitor was answered in the wrong language or an operator line was not English.

criteria.name: Asked, never guessed
criteria.prompt: Whenever the request was vague, matched several places, or was not on the map, the agent asked one short question or said it did not know and offered a person. FAIL if it guessed a place, a position, or invented a place that is not on the floor.

criteria.name: Clean stop and arrival
criteria.prompt: For every trip that was started: it ended with 'Operator: stop here, please' and an arrival line to the visitor in their language, OR it was explicitly changed to a new destination with the operator told to stop first, OR it was cancelled. FAIL if a trip just trailed off, or an arrival was announced without a stop line.

criteria.name: Stayed brief
criteria.prompt: The agent gave one step at a time and kept visitor replies to one or two sentences. FAIL if it listed several steps at once, repeated a step nobody asked for, or lectured.

destination.description: The final destination of the trip, in English, e.g. 'second call booth'. Empty if no trip started.

visitor_language.description: Language code the first visitor spoke, e.g. ar, en, hi, es.

languages_used.description: All languages spoken by visitors in this conversation, as codes separated by commas.

destination_changed.description: True if a second destination was requested while a trip was in progress.

unknown_requests.description: Places or things visitors asked for that are NOT on the floor map, in English, separated by commas. Empty if none. This list is used to improve the map.

position_questions.description: How many times the agent had to ask where the robot was (what was passed last, or what is next to the robot).

human_requested.description: True if the agent called request_human or sent the visitor to a person.

steps_given.description: How many 'Operator:' walking instructions were given in total.
